projects.name: Polaris Forge 1
projects.quote: During the quarter ended August 31, 2025, we signed an additional 150 MW lease for our Polaris Forge 1 campus, bringing the full 400 MW of critical IT load under contract with CoreWeave and securing approximately $11 billion in prospective lease revenue over the approximately 15 year terms.

projects.name: Polaris Forge 1 first 100 MW facility
projects.quote: Our first 100 MW facility at Polaris Forge 1 remains on track to be operational in calendar Q4 2025, with technical fit-out activities underway this quarter and continuing into next.

projects.name: Polaris Forge 1 second 150 MW facility
projects.quote: Our second 150 MW facility is scheduled for mid-2026, followed by our third 150 MW facility planned for 2027.

projects.name: Polaris Forge 1 third 150 MW facility
projects.quote: Our second 150 MW facility is scheduled for mid-2026, followed by our third 150 MW facility planned for 2027.

projects.name: Polaris Forge 2
projects.quote: Secured $50 million in funding from Macquarie Equipment Capital, Inc. for our approximately $3 billion, 300 MW IT load AI Factory campus near Harwood, North Dakota ("Polaris Forge 2").

projects.name: Jamestown, North Dakota data center
projects.quote: As of August 31, 2025, the Company’s 106 MW facility in Jamestown, N.D., and 180 MW facility in Ellendale, N.D., are operating at full capacity.
